title: Optimistic Responses
description: Implement optimistic UI updates with Apollo Client for instant user feedback.

data.text: Optimistic responses let you update the UI immediately when a mutation is triggered, before the server responds. Apollo Client applies the optimistic response to the cache, giving the user instant feedback. If the mutation succeeds, the real response replaces the optimistic one. If it fails, the cache rolls back.
